reference: Protected six-model stoppage consensus in data/control_broadcast_v1; existing candidates and ledger remain untouched until new rows are appended.
hypotheses_ranked: Team-tagged player formations can distinguish corresponding moments in the two unsynchronized recordings without player identity or possession labels.
Local temporal agreement can reject cuts, replays at incompatible rates and accidental formation matches. Ambiguous mappings should remain missing rather than be forced.
A confidently aligned second-camera ball/player view may correct ownership evidence unavailable from the tactical track alone.
data: Local supplied tactical and broadcast tracking/metadata/homography-validity only. No video/image extraction, private labels, annotations, external data upload or cloud processing. Public targets are not read by alignment or feature construction.

alignment.sampling: Tactical and broadcast anchors every25frames on each source's zero-based timeline, with25frame edge margins. Require valid homography and>=4 finite in-pitch players per team. Coordinates are metres; permit5metres beyond each pitch boundary. Metadata team order is reconciled by normalized club-name similarity, never targets.
alignment.coarse: For each tactical anchor, search every eligible broadcast anchor and four fixed coordinate reflections. Per team, take each broadcast player's nearest same-team tactical-player distance, cap at10metres, average squared distances; score is root mean of the two team means. No identities, ball positions or labels enter the matching cost.
alignment.margin: Runner-up cost excludes broadcast anchors within250frames of the best match, across all orientations. Require the best orientation to agree at adjacent tactical anchors and neighboring broadcast increments to differ from25 by<=25frames.
alignment.fine: Search each candidate broadcast frame within25frames of its coarse match. Score the mean squared formation errors at tactical/broadcast offsets-25,0,+25. Require all3 comparisons valid. Fine uncertainty is the span of candidates within.05metres of the best cost. No ball or target information chooses offsets.
alignment.mapping: Interpolate only between adjacent25frame tactical anchors accepted by a profile, with identical orientation and broadcast/tactical rate in[.8,1.2]. Round mapped broadcast indices to nearest frame. No extrapolation, gap filling or interpolation across rejected anchors; recheck broadcast validity/track counts for mapped frames. Tactical observation context is at most50frames; broadcast search covers its full supplied timeline.

feasibility: Evaluate each profile using observations only within the public development frame range. Prefer strict if mapping coverage>=10%, mapped finite broadcast-ball coverage>=5%, and median ball disagreement<=5metres on>=100 jointly observed ball frames. Otherwise use relaxed if it passes those same gates. If neither passes, retain all alignment diagnostics and stop before possession fitting. These are geometry/coverage checks, not independent correspondence ground truth.
features: Aligned broadcast-ball geometry against broadcast players and against tactical players: per-team nearest3 distances, supplied nearest-player speed, counts within1/3/5metres, advantage and control share; match validity, ball visibility, formation cost and ambiguity. Optional past/future25/75/125-frame summaries of aligned ownership evidence. No frame numbers, absolute coordinates or target labels are model inputs. Combined tactical context<=175frames, covered by the existing250frame buffers. Actual padded/full-prefix feature parity required.

models.broadcast_fast_same: Original fast inputs plus same-camera broadcast geometry/quality; unchanged fit_control.
models.broadcast_fast_cross: Original fast inputs plus same/cross-camera broadcast geometry and bounded summaries; unchanged fit_control.
models.broadcast_joint_frame: Original ordered inputs plus all broadcast features; unchanged depth3/160-tree joint XGBoost, frame-balanced objective.

screen.replace_head: Use new raw probabilities only where a matched broadcast ball is observed, retaining original probabilities elsewhere. Fast models replace only fast head; joint models replace only current ordered head. All remaining heads and canonical six-model inference are unchanged.
screen.short_proposals: Keep selected D mask. New head's centered11+penalty3 proposes H/A runs8..125, mean conditional confidence>=.65, no referenceD overlap,>=50% matched broadcast-ball coverage,>=3 contact-supported frames from the corresponding broadcast geometry, and opposite reference control on a majority of each neighboring13frames. All gates read unchanged reference. No manually chosen frame edits.

confirmation: Freeze at most one unchanged finalist before scoring seeds43/44 in all protocols. Full reproducible CSV, actual-source/cache/model checks, official scores and independent review are required before promotion.

promotion.all_pairs: No primary regression; MacroF1>=reference-.005; D recall>=reference-.02; no extra mostly missed stoppage; no previously mostly recovered short run lost; falseD<=reference+10frames.
promotion.substantial: Buffered primary gain>=.04 for each seed, positive mean primary gain in each other protocol, improved mean short IoU and at least one additional buffered short IoU>=.5 match.
promotion.selection: Largest minimum paired primary gain, then mean short IoU. Record every block regression; otherwise keep current selection.

limitations: Alignment has no provided correspondence ground truth. Synthetic tests and physical consistency are necessary engineering checks, not proof of correct real timing. All public model comparisons remain heavily adaptive same-match development, not independent or private full-match accuracy.
